newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Shell sees Sydney cracker back up late Monday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Shell sees Sydney cracker back up late Monday.

text.p: The catalytic cracker at Shell Australia Ltd's Clyde refinery in Sydney will be brought back into full operation on Monday night after an unscheduled week-long shutdown, the company said.
"By tonight things will be operating normally again," a spokesman for Shell told Reuters.
The cracker, which is the second stage of the refining process after crude distillation, was shut down on September 9 due to a blockage, he said. The spokesman did not give details.
The shutdown did not affect supplies to refinery customers or supplies of crude into the plant, he said.
